say:1:1510277001:1.source_cn: 狩猎神，我们等你的决断。

say:2:1510277002:1.text: Should we hand the prisoners back for gain or seize the moment and take Mirehold by force?
say:2:1510277002:1.source_cn: 放回俘虏，换取好处；还是借此机会，一举夺回水泽营地？

choice_prompt:3:1510277002.text: Should we hand the prisoners back for gain or seize the moment and take Mirehold by force?
choice_prompt:3:1510277002.source_cn: 放回俘虏，换取好处；还是借此机会，一举夺回水泽营地？

say:4:1510277003:1.text: The Wildborn will obey their god.
say:4:1510277003:1.male: The Wildborn will obey their god.
say:4:1510277003:1.female: The Wildborn will obey their goddess.

say:5:1510277004:1.text: I'll announce to the Wildborn that the Herdmaster will take the reins himself.
say:5:1510277004:1.source_cn: 我会向部落宣布，兽群之主将亲自出征！
say:5:1510277004:1.male: I'll announce to the Wildborn that the Herdmaster will take the reins himself.
say:5:1510277004:1.female: I'll announce to the Wildborn that the Herdmaster will take the reins herself.

say:6:1510277005:1.text: Go with the Herdmaster, Gala. Witness his holy deeds, and bring every tale back to the Wildborn.
say:6:1510277005:1.source_cn: 加拉，你随狩猎神一起去。去见证神的一切行事，回来向雅库...
say:6:1510277005:1.male: Go with the Herdmaster, Gala. Witness his holy deeds, and bring every tale back to the Wildborn.
say:6:1510277005:1.female: Go with the Herdmaster, Gala. Witness her holy deeds, and bring every tale back to the Wildborn.

say:8:1510277006:0.text: Yes, I will follow the Divine One, no matter where he goes.
say:8:1510277006:0.source_cn: 是。加拉会紧随狩猎神大人。
say:8:1510277006:0.male: Yes, I will follow the Divine One, no matter where he goes.
say:8:1510277006:0.female: Yes, I will follow the Divine One, no matter where she goes.

say:9:1510277007:1.text: May the Herdmaster be victorious. May the Wild Moon stain with blood.
say:9:1510277007:1.source_cn: 愿兽群之主旗开得胜，雅库伯尔之月永远鲜红！
say:9:1510277007:1.male: May the Herdmaster be victorious. May the Wild Moon stain with blood.
say:9:1510277007:1.female: May the Herdmaster be victorious. May the Wild Moon stain with blood.

narration:10:1510277008:0.text: Your last night with the Wildborn is still as lively as ever.
narration:10:1510277008:0.source_cn: 你在雅库伯尔的最后一晚依旧热闹非凡
narration:10:1510277008:0.male: Your last night with the Wildborn is still as lively as ever.
narration:10:1510277008:0.female: Your last night with the Wildborn is still as lively as ever.

narration:11:1510277009:0.text: Dawn breaks. The Wildborn gather, their thunderous cheers shaking the earth as you march onward.
narration:11:1510277009:0.source_cn: 第二天，兽人们声势浩大地送你离开……

choice:3:0:1.text: I will take the captives for negotiations.
choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 我带俘虏去和人类统帅交涉
choice:3:0:1.male: I will take the captives for negotiations.
choice:3:0:1.female: I will take the captives for negotiations.

choice:3:1:2.text: Trust me and victory will be at hand.
choice:3:1:2.male: Trust me and victory will be at hand.
choice:3:1:2.female: Trust me and victory will be at hand.
